headline.title: The AI Hype Index: AI gets booed in graduation season
headline.summary: During a recent graduation ceremony at the University of Arizona, former Google CEO Eric Schmidt faced boos from the audience when he urged graduates to help shape the future of AI. This incident highlights a growing skepticism among younger generations regarding the impact and direction of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Vertu wants CEOs to run companies from an AI foldable starting at $6,880
articles.summary: Vertu has introduced a new foldable smartphone designed for CEOs, featuring AI-agent workflows and enterprise integrations, starting at a price of $6,880. The device is built on the open-source Hermes project and emphasizes luxury finishes alongside its technological capabilities.

articles.title: Amazon Thinks the Future of Data Centers Depends on a Technical Problem It Just Solved
articles.summary: Amazon has announced a significant breakthrough in data-center networking that enhances the speed of information transfer within its cloud infrastructure. This advancement is expected to play a crucial role in the future development of data centers.

articles.title: YouTube will let you ask AI to make a custom video feed
articles.summary: YouTube is introducing a new AI feature that allows users to create personalized video feeds by describing their interests, moods, or favorite topics. These custom feeds can be pinned to the top of the user's homepage for easy access.

articles.title: Why Google’s AI can’t spell Google (or anything else)
articles.summary: A recent analysis highlights that Google's AI struggles with basic spelling tasks, including the ability to spell its own name correctly. This issue raises concerns about the reliability and accuracy of the technology in handling simple language tasks.

articles.title: Illinois Lawmakers Just Passed America’s Strongest AI Safety Bill
articles.summary: Illinois lawmakers have passed a comprehensive AI safety bill that mandates companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, to undergo third-party verification of their adherence to safety standards. Governor JB Pritzker has indicated his intention to sign the bill into law.

articles.title: In more good news for Amazon, Snowflake signs $6B deal with AWS for AI CPU chips
articles.summary: Snowflake has entered a five-year agreement with Amazon Web Services worth $6 billion to procure AI CPU chips. This deal highlights the growing competition in the AI hardware market, particularly for Nvidia.

articles.title: Payroll startup Remote says it grew revenue 50% per employee without adding headcount
articles.summary: Payroll startup Remote has achieved over $300 million in annual recurring revenue and reached cash-flow positivity, driven by a 50% increase in revenue per employee through the adoption of AI technologies. The company accomplished this growth without adding to its workforce.

articles.title: Laguna M.1/XS.2 Technical Report
articles.summary: The Laguna M.1 and Laguna XS.2 are new Mixture-of-Experts foundation models designed for long-horizon coding tasks, with M.1 featuring 225.8 billion parameters and XS.2 having 33.4 billion parameters. Both models were developed using a comprehensive internal system called the Model Factory, which integrates data management, training, evaluation, and inference processes.

articles.title: AIBuildAI-2: A Knowledge-Enhanced Agent for Automatically Building AI Models
articles.summary: AIBuildAI-2 is a new knowledge-enhanced agent designed to automate the process of building AI models, addressing the challenges faced by practitioners, particularly in scientific fields lacking AI engineering expertise. The system aims to streamline model development by minimizing manual tasks such as architecture design and training pipeline construction.

articles.title: MTAVG-Bench 2.0: Diagnosing Failure Modes of Cinematic Expressiveness in Multi-Talker Audio-Video Generation
articles.summary: The article introduces MTAVG-Bench 2.0, a new framework designed to evaluate the cinematic expressiveness of Multi-Talker Audio-Video Generation models. It highlights the limitations of current metrics in assessing scene-level generation and emphasizes the need for models to achieve coherent character performance and higher-level cinematic qualities.

articles.title: SafeMed-R1: Clinician-Audited Safety and Ethics Alignment for Medical Large Language Models
articles.summary: The article introduces SafeMed-R1, a large language model designed for clinical use, which incorporates a Clinical Trust Signals (CTS) pipeline to ensure auditable reasoning and alignment with safety and ethical standards. This model aims to address the limitations of current LLMs in routine clinical applications by enhancing governance and resilience against misuse.
